elements.element: No non-solicitation obligation binding Customer at all
elements.evidence: "it will not in any way solicit for employment any Transferred Employees directly involved in the Services" — a non-solicit still binds the parties
"This restriction is mutual and binds MSL equally with respect to IBM personnel directly involved in the Services"

elements.element: Scope limited to personnel directly involved in the services
elements.evidence: "any Transferred Employees directly involved in the Services" / "IBM personnel directly involved in the Services"

elements.element: Duration of 12 months measured from the end of the individual's involvement
elements.evidence: "for a period of 12 months from the end of their involvement in the Services" and "for 12 months from the end of their involvement"
"by using general employment advertising or communications or independent search firms, hiring any person who responds thereto"; insertion "excludes general advertisements"
"employing any such person who contacts IBM on his or her own initiative without any solicitation or encouragement from IBM"; insertion "and unsolicited approaches"
only "solicit for employment" is restricted; hiring of responders/self-initiated contacts is expressly permitted

reasons: The redline lands squarely at the locked fallback: scope narrowed to personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months running from the end of involvement, mutual application to MSL, and express general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, with no no-hire covenant.
The preferred position (no non-solicit binding Customer) is not achieved, but that is permitted by the locked target level.

Changes are confined to the duration/scope operator in the existing sentence plus one concise sentence needed to supply mutuality and the carve-outs on the MSL side; the consent mechanic and the pre-existing exceptions remain intact, and no undefined terms or dangling mechanics are introduced.
